skill.name: infsh-cli
skill.description: Guides agents through the inference.sh belt CLI for discovering AI apps, running model jobs, tracking tasks, and handling authentication.
skill.summary: Use the inference.sh belt CLI to run hosted AI apps and manage task results.
skill.author: halt-catch-fire

security_audit.summary: The skill is a community CLI integration that intentionally runs external commands and contacts inference.sh services. The remote installer uses curl piped to sh in multiple files, and local file upload plus Twitter/X automation create high-impact side effects that require explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is executed through curl piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell instructions with version-pinned package manager or release downloads verified before execution.

remediation.issue: Manual install command builds a download URL from a remote manifest using shell command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Provide explicit platform-specific download commands or a signed package manager flow without dynamic shell parsing.

remediation.issue: The skill can upload local files to hosted apps when paths are supplied as inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running any command that references local files or parent-directory paths.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X actions can post, message, follow, like, or retweet from a connected account.
remediation.suggestion: Require a user-approved final preview before any social media action or account-changing command is executed.

remediation.issue: The tool permission allows all belt subcommands.
remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed commands to the minimum app discovery and task execution subcommands needed by this skill.

content.user_title: Run AI Apps from the inference.sh CLI
content.value_statement: AI teams often switch between many model APIs and tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation and authentication for the belt CLI.
Finds hosted apps by category, search term, feature status, or app name.
Generates sample inputs and runs hosted image, video, audio, text, and search apps.
Tracks long-running tasks and saves generated results through the CLI.
Supports local media inputs that the CLI uploads for compatible apps.
Points users to focused skills for images, video, search, LLMs, and Twitter/X automation.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account, credentials, and available account credits.
Requires the belt CLI to be installed and available in the shell.
Results depend on remote app availability, schemas, rate limits, and provider behavior.
Local file uploads and social actions need explicit user approval before execution.

use_cases.title: Create Media Assets
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, avatars, audio, and 3D assets through hosted model apps.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Model Workflows
use_cases.description: Discover apps, inspect schemas, run samples, and compare model outputs from one CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Run Approved External Actions
use_cases.description: Use search apps or approved Twitter/X workflows after confirming prompts, media, and account actions.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Find an inference.sh app for image generation. Show the best options and explain which one fits my prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use inference.sh to generate one image from this prompt. Ask before running any command that spends credits.

prompt_templates.title: Use Local Media Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an image-to-video run using my local file. Confirm the exact file path with me before upload.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate Multi-Step Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a workflow that searches the web, drafts a media prompt, runs a video model, and tracks the task until completion.

output_examples.input: Find a fast video generation app for a mountain drone shot.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a suitable video app, lists required input fields, estimates likely wait time, and asks before spending credits.

output_examples.input: Turn my product photo into a short social clip.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the local file path, selects an image-to-video app, describes the upload step, and waits for approval.

output_examples.input: Check the result of my long-running generation task.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves task status, summarizes progress, and explains where to find completed media links.

best_practices: Confirm app names, inputs, costs, and account-changing actions before running commands.
Use sample inputs and app schemas before submitting expensive or long-running jobs.
Review every local file path before allowing the CLI to upload files.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installer scripts into a shell without verification.
Do not let agents choose local file paths without user approval.
Do not automate Twitter/X posting or messaging without a final user preview.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents use the inference.sh belt CLI to find apps, run hosted model jobs, and track results.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need inference.sh credentials, and some jobs may require credits or provider access.

faq.question: Can it run image and video models?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include image, video, audio, text, search, 3D, and utility app examples.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI can upload local paths for compatible apps, so confirm each path before use.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: Yes, the skill lists Twitter/X app examples. Users should approve the exact text and media before execution.

faq.question: Is it safe to install automatically?
faq.answer: No. The current instructions include remote installer execution, so manual verification is recommended.
